_about: Hand-kept by the lead at each merge: phase items and the PR-to-phase map. `python tools/journal.py` builds docs/roadmap/journal/index.html from this file plus DECISIONS.md, the roadmap note tables and the PR cache; `--check` fails when a merged PR is missing from `prs`.

days.title: Kickoff
days.text: The scaffold, a greybox rampage slice and 39 rulings in one day: an active game, never idle; voxels; Look C concrete realism; three species, each its own way to play; a kaiju that starts young and outscaled by the city; a 4K TV as the target screen. Street life, a real street plan, the Kaiju Claw font and the species branches all merged before midnight.

days.title: Factory proof
days.text: The asset factory proved itself: a Blender tank and attack helicopter in the game, the croc titan design chosen and rigged, kaiju drawn as voxel cubes on a smooth skin. The repo went public to get CI minutes back. The demo was defined: croc only, hatchling to Behemoth. Emergency Broadcast UI on every screen; a Windows export proved locally. Thirty merges.

days.title: The demo chain and the first playtest
days.text: Forty-four rulings and thirty-one merges built the demo: baby and adolescent croc bodies, a professional army, rooftop squads, greenery, the stadium and the Sky Wheel, one random sport per run, the full sound mix. At 11:44 the director started playing demo exe 1 and typed twelve notes as he went. Verdict: a very good start, not shippable as is.

days.title: Playtest fixes, and the big call
days.text: Playtest fixes came first (D-083). No building is too strong for the baby; sound from ElevenLabs; the river start. Then the decision that reshaped everything after it: real carving destruction, option A, top priority. The first three carving work packages opened the same day, including a native C++ carve core.

days.title: Carving lands; build 2 played
days.text: Work packages 4 to 7 merged: buildings drawn from cell grids, carved towers falling by real physics. The director played carving build 2 and left thirty notes, then picked the Cinematic shader, camera C and every time of day. Every open item was sorted into one chronological post-demo plan, phases A to H.

days.title: Research day
days.text: Twenty-six research files were folded into the roadmap as R n.m references. The croc's breath became hot lightning, not atomic; the look stays voxel with the kaiju at double resolution; the game ends with a mecha boss after three cities; Suno got its yes; fire returns as gameplay; one city is a water city. Heavy destruction went native (worst step 1222 ms to 293 ms), five graphics presets landed, and the UI redesign was bumped up the list.

days.title: Weight, the Taskforce and the Itch demo
days.text: The kaiju turns with weight: the baby smoothly, the adults stepping real turns. The 1.0 demo will go to invite-only testers on Itch once the reptilian stage is complete. The Anti Kaiju Taskforce arrived in the plan (jetpack agents, railguns, frost grenades) and became the next build. Landmarks became a rotating stable of twelve. The fourth growth step, never a decision, was cut. Playtest milestones M1 to M4 replaced per-change clips.

days.title: After the demo
days.text: A day of rulings, D-147 to D-190. The demo now ends when the whole upgrade tree is unlocked, about two hours in, then Endless mode. Motion and destruction come first, behind a motion gate. The music ships: an original theme in the style of the 1954 Godzilla score, re-arranged per city and opening low and creeping. Taskforce squads fire in turn; helicopters fight as stand-off gunships. The big forms turn heavier and slower, and fire becomes smooth, realistic flames. A third lead session took on the atmosphere. This journal was started.

days.title: Three reptilians and a new way to animate
days.text: The Komodo dragon arrived as a full Tripo model, upright. Shown it walking in the game on a Cascadeur clip, he said 'Yes, adopt it' (D-199), and every kaiju now gets its clips from Cascadeur. The reptilian family took shape: Komodo (heavy), croc (medium) and serpent (light), picked from the baby stage, each with its own tree, croc first, then dragon, then snake (D-197, D-202). The serpent became a hybrid that starts as a spitting cobra, gains a rattle and ends as a constrictor (D-206). The final boss became a mecha chimera of all three (D-211), the scope was written down as demo, full game, expansion (D-212), and New Game was ruled to become Kaiju Creation, a lab with a petri dish and an egg cracking (D-207). He called the fat adult croc out and had it remade sleek and athletic (D-219). Tripo credits for the reptilian models rose to 10,000 in two steps (D-204, D-213). Twenty-nine rulings, D-196 to D-224. Merged: a cheaper Thunder Beam so the last unlock lands near 2.25 hours, the per-run memory leak closed, and the animation clips shipped in exported builds.

days.title: Kaiju Creation ships; the critics go
days.text: New Game now opens in a dark secret lab built from Tripo props: he picks a genome, the injector does the work, Special K goes in, an egg cracks (D-235, D-236, D-241: 'Ship it'). Nimbalyst joined as a developer; its first task was Kaiju Creation, then the trains (D-232, D-240). The Komodo walks with his forearms up and forward, claws reaching ahead (D-234), and the drool is not negotiable (D-239). He asked for real water, with a wake and waves (D-244), set out the vision the critics judge by (D-242: elegant and restrained effects, true to reference, wide framing, gore and drool celebrated) and then dropped the critics altogether (D-249). When the far insectoid was found missing from the game, an audit of finished work not in the game was written (#201). Handoffs moved to one folder outside git (D-248). Merged: Kaiju Creation, a solid aim wedge behind the kaiju, a title without the yellow bar, a stomp that hurts what is under the foot, the motion gate tightened per growth step. Twenty-five rulings, D-225 to D-249.

days.title: The leap, the interviews and the render plan
days.text: Every visual now goes straight to him, judged by no agent (D-250). Croc work came first for the Itch demo, the dragon was paused (D-252), carving became universal for every building and structure, the railway included (D-253), and he ruled the play area 1.5x wider (D-254). Districts grow by stage (D-255) from Tripo buildings, hero pieces and 40 fillers (D-256). Three interviews (D-259, D-260, D-263) settled run length, the combo, the croc kit, defeat and the demo shell: the croc leaps instead of dashing, high onto a roof, and carves what it hits on the way (D-262, D-268); the stomp plays 20% slower (D-264). Beachfront became a new district (D-269). From 23:00 the render plan took every builder slot (D-276) and the night sky took its fog from the sky (D-279). Merged: trains on an elevated railway, clean roads, gunships that hold a ring, the far insectoid back on the skyline, the adult croc remade, three save slots, the leap, a results screen, rebindable controls, photo mode, a threat meter, red barrels that explode and chain, rain round 1 and the leader's escape helicopter. Thirty rulings, D-250 to D-279.

days.title: Night shift: debt first
days.text: He went to sleep with the work running and the rule that visual changes go into the game and wait for his morning interview (D-308). He ruled the stomp off the croc: its footfalls hurt street-level things on their own, a tail lash takes the button, and the charged stomp becomes the dragon's attack (D-280, D-281). He ruled out floating biomass numbers ('i want to see kaiju', D-284) and any vehicle going see-through (D-290), and chose the new colour grading and both clean-ups (D-285). He asked for every tech-debt item to be actioned (D-295), then put debt ahead of the render plan (D-300); builders are limited only by what the PC and the tests can carry (D-296), and each speed run gets the PC to itself (D-299). Cascadeur is bought just before release (D-301). The croc walk is being reworked from the Dracorex study in his open Cascadeur (D-302, D-305 to D-307). Merged overnight: the freeze fix, the first render-plan savings, the baseline speed bench, and the debt rows (committed .uid files, Git LFS, data schemas, an enforced licence register, a faster pre-push check, tool tests, 61 dead scripts deleted, stale handoffs removed). This day's merge counter reads zero: GitHub dates a merge in UTC, and these landed in the small hours here. Thirty-nine rulings so far, D-280 to D-318.

highlights.quote: ive seen enough to pause the playtest, its not shippable as is. its a very good start though, well done
highlights.effect: Playtest fixes first (D-083); twelve notes became the fix queue.

highlights.quote: i want real dynamic destruction, actual physics and buildings than can be carved by giant monsters
highlights.effect: Real carving became option A and top priority (D-094, D-097); seven work packages followed.

highlights.quote: a building shouldnt have a health bar, it should be a phyiscal structure which obeys the laws of physics and simply must be dismantled
highlights.effect: Phase C's bar: effortless carving even for a baby (b2-4).

highlights.quote: our kaiju should have real weight behind them, feel lumbering and unstoppable
highlights.effect: Turning with weight: arcs, the head leads, adults step their turns (D-130, D-131).

highlights.quote: dont waste time chasing marginal gains, get things implemented and we can polish later
highlights.effect: A standing rule for every builder.

highlights.quote: ours is like a crocodile in a t-rex body, not godzilla shaped
highlights.effect: The breath became hot lightning; the legal look check closed (D-108, D-112).

highlights.quote: im still interested in Fire as a source of lighting and gameplay (perhaps natural flame that can spread (unlockable in skill tree) and add to your biomass collection)
highlights.effect: Fire gameplay: City Ablaze and four more headline nodes (D-126); fire spread PR in flight.

highlights.quote: the UI should be as minimal as possible because we want to emphasise the full glory of our kaiju and the city's destruction. we dont want the UI distracting from our trump card
highlights.effect: The HUD stripped to a plain timer, small corner icons and a boxless biomass figure.

highlights.quote: think smarter, not harder, the tank doesnt need to avoid the breath, just let it die
highlights.effect: No convoy re-plan; tanks caught by the longer breath just die (D-144).

highlights.quote: Special Agents fly around the city with jetpacks and grappling hooks
highlights.effect: The Anti Kaiju Taskforce, built before the Itch demo (D-137).

highlights.quote: i dont want to play every single update, you need to identify milestones in the roadmap that justify my playtest and craft a survey for that game state
highlights.effect: Four playtest milestones M1 to M4 replace per-change clips (D-146).

highlights.quote: when the Reptilian stage is 100% implemented: bug free, polished visuals, good performance, fully featured
highlights.effect: The bar for the 1.0 demo on invite-only Itch (D-132).

highlights.quote: i think we should measure until the upgrade tree is fully unlocked (2 hours roughly)
highlights.effect: The demo ends on the final upgrade, about two hours in, then Endless mode (D-156).

highlights.quote: motion, alongside the destruction mechanics, is the most important element of our design. If we cant sell the fantasy of piloting a Kaiju then the game wont be fun
highlights.effect: Motion first: a motion gate on every body or movement change (D-177).

highlights.quote: start them now, create a third session
highlights.effect: M1's atmosphere starts at once in a third lead session (D-189).

highlights.quote: i think we should make it a choice from the baby stage
highlights.effect: The reptilian family: Komodo (heavy), croc (medium) and serpent (light), picked from the baby stage (D-197).

highlights.quote: Kaiju Creation (aka NEW GAME) / laboratory setting, zoomed in petrie dish / you select which reptile genome to place in the dish
highlights.effect: New Game became a lab opening in the demo; it shipped the next day (D-207, D-241).

highlights.quote: I REALLY hate our croc, why is he so fat and bulky, hes meant to be sleek and athletic>?
highlights.effect: The adult croc was remade from the teen's lean build and kept (D-219, D-221).

highlights.quote: the drool is a non-negotiable aspect of the Dragon's design
highlights.effect: Drool stays on every Komodo model, clip and stage (D-239).

highlights.quote: water also counts as a flat untextured surface. Not for the first time, Im asking you for real water
highlights.effect: Real water with a full wake, built beside the ground texturing (D-244).

highlights.quote: abandon our critics, all art passes through you who ACTUALLY LOOKS AT IT and then ASK ME, so the builders are never judging the art, only you and me
highlights.effect: No critic agents on any project (D-249); the next day every visual went straight to him (D-250).

highlights.quote: just show me the clip, i will immediately know what is wrong and can describe the fix, you then workout how to do that fix
highlights.effect: Every visual goes to him with no agent verdict; he names the defect, the lead works out the fix (D-250).

highlights.quote: carve is a universal feature for all buildings
highlights.effect: Every building and structure, the railway included, breaks through the one carve path; a test fails any other way (D-253).

highlights.quote: it looks too fast, it makes it looks weightless rather than titanic
highlights.effect: The stomp plays 20% slower, and an upgrade node wins part of the speed back (D-264).

highlights.quote: he should carve right through what he hits in mid air and land with a smash
highlights.effect: Every leap carves through what it hits in flight, then lands with a smash (D-268).

highlights.quote: a stationary stomp goes against the croc's power fantasy as an athletic kaiju
highlights.effect: The croc's footfalls hurt on their own, a tail lash takes the button, and the charged stomp moves to the dragon (D-280, D-281).

highlights.quote: i dont want to see the numbers. i want to see kaiju
highlights.effect: Every floating biomass number is removed (D-284).

highlights.quote: I want the FULL list of debt items, i want them all actioned
highlights.effect: A tech-debt list with an owner and a PR on every row; debt fixes then went ahead of the render plan (D-295, D-300).

highlights.quote: any visual work is fine but after the first iteration save it and show me in interview tomorrow
highlights.effect: Night-shift visual changes go into the game after one iteration and wait for his morning verdict; what he rejects is reverted (D-308).
